text: Steenbarger, on COLD: no decider on my reading wants the dip itself. minervini, seow (h1_close_above:bar_high), wyckoff (reclaim:vwap_14d) and I (reclaim:ma_20) all ask for a turn out of the pullback; livermore and oneil want a fresh closing high. The common ground is the turn, not in_zone:ma_20. I hold ABSTAIN: W swing_class LH/LL gives no established weekly trend to retrace within (C2, C7; adx NOT_SERVED), and C11 wants the turn visible first. Clears with reclaim:ma_20 on H1, the 20-day reached and an hourly close back above it.
